residence_time_min.text: Calculation estimated τ = 20 min (IF=15×) for a 38.24 mL reactor. Inventory constrains reactor to 3.0 mL (reactor_h2_pbr_300). At Q=0.5 mL/min liquid, τ_liquid = 3.0/0.5 = 6.0 min. Inlet/STP basis: τ_inlet = 3.0/(0.5 + 5 sccm × 1 mL/60s) = 3.0/0.583 = 5.1 min. Reported 6.0 min (liquid basis) as primary handle. (b) Analogy 2 is photocatalytic packed-bed C-N coupling — similar packed-bed format but photocatalytic, no H2 gas, 180 min residence time at 0.01 mL/min; key difference is no gas feed and photocatalysis vs hydrogenolysis; 180 min not applicable. (c) Analogy 3 is photoredox C-N coupling — dissimilar; 60 min residence time in photochemical reactor; not applicable. All analogies chemically dissimilar; engineering calculation and inventory constraint are primary basis.

chemistry_notes.text: Reaction: heterogeneous N-benzhydryl hydrogenolysis of DMAOL over Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 (Pearlman's catalyst on alumina) under H2 at 21 bar/60°C in methanol. Mechanism: H2 dissociative chemisorption on Pd(0) → surface hydride → adsorption of DMAOL via benzhydryl C-N bond → hydride delivery cleaves C-N → 3-azetidinol + diphenylmethane desorb. Rate-limiting step is gas-liquid H2 mass transfer to catalyst surface. Batch gave only 38.1% conversion in 5 h at 21 bar, indicating severe mass-transfer limitation in stirred autoclave. Flow packed-bed provides 10–50× higher gas-liquid interfacial area (Taylor/trickle flow), expected to dramatically improve H2 delivery to Pd surface. Engineering calculations: τ = 20 min (IF = 15× vs batch), Q_liquid = 0.5 mL/min, V_reactor = 3.0 mL (inventory constraint — reactor_h2_pbr_300). Actual τ = 3.0 mL / 0.5 mL/min = 6.0 min liquid-phase residence time; this is shorter than the 20 min calculation target but is constrained by the fixed 3 mL inventory reactor. The 6 min flow residence time vs 300 min batch time represents a 50× intensification — consistent with mass-transfer-limited regime where flow advantage is large. BPR set to 21 bar (only available setpoint, matches batch pressure exactly). Analogies 1–3 are all dissimilar chemistry (Claisen rearrangement, photocatalytic C-N coupling) and provide no directly applicable hardware parameters; engineering calculations and Chemistry Plan are the primary basis. Particle size of Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 must be confirmed (target dp < 0.435 mm = ID/10 for 4.35 mm ID tube) before packing. Recommended_disposition: SCREEN — first experiment to establish conversion vs residence time baseline; catalyst lifetime and optimal gas:liquid ratio require experimental determination.

chemistry_notes.text: Reaction: heterogeneous N-benzhydryl hydrogenolysis of DMAOL over Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 (Pearlman's catalyst on alumina) under H2 at 21 bar/60°C in methanol. Mechanism: H2 dissociative chemisorption on Pd(0) → surface hydride → adsorption of DMAOL via benzhydryl C-N bond → hydride delivery cleaves C-N → 3-azetidinol + diphenylmethane desorb. Rate-limiting step is gas-liquid H2 mass transfer to catalyst surface. Batch gave only 38.1% conversion in 5 h at 21 bar, indicating severe mass-transfer limitation in stirred autoclave. Flow packed-bed provides 10–50× higher gas-liquid interfacial area (Taylor/trickle flow), expected to dramatically improve H2 delivery to Pd surface. Engineering calculations: τ = 20 min (IF = 15× vs batch), Q_liquid = 0.5 mL/min, V_reactor = 3.0 mL (inventory constraint — reactor_h2_pbr_300). Actual τ = 3.0 mL / 0.5 mL/min = 6.0 min liquid-phase residence time; this is shorter than the 20 min calculation target but is constrained by the fixed 3 mL inventory reactor. The 6 min flow residence time vs 300 min batch time represents a 50× intensification — consistent with mass-transfer-limited regime where flow advantage is large. BPR set to 21 bar (only available setpoint, matches batch pressure exactly). Analogies 1–3 are all dissimilar chemistry (Claisen rearrangement, photocatalytic C-N coupling) and provide no directly applicable hardware parameters; engineering calculations and Chemistry Plan are the primary basis. Particle size of Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 must be confirmed (target dp < 0.435 mm = ID/10 for 4.35 mm ID tube) before packing. Recommended_disposition: SCREEN — first experiment to establish conversion vs residence time baseline; catalyst lifetime and optimal gas:liquid ratio require experimental determination.

Adsorption of DMAOL onto Pd surface via the benzhydryl C–N bond (η¹ or η² coordination of the phenyl ring or C–N bond to Pd)

Hydrogenolysis: Pd–H delivers hydride to the benzhydryl carbon, cleaving the C–N bond; azetidine nitrogen is protonated by solvent (methanol) to give azetidinium, then 3-azetidinol; benzhydryl fragment desorbs as diphenylmethane
Desorption of 3-azetidinol and diphenylmethane from Pd surface; Pd sites regenerated for next catalytic cycle

chemistry_notes.text: Reaction: heterogeneous N-benzhydryl hydrogenolysis of DMAOL over Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 (Pearlman's catalyst on alumina) under H2 at 21 bar/60°C in methanol. Mechanism: H2 dissociative chemisorption on Pd(0) → surface hydride → adsorption of DMAOL via benzhydryl C-N bond → hydride delivery cleaves C-N → 3-azetidinol + diphenylmethane desorb. Rate-limiting step is gas-liquid H2 mass transfer to catalyst surface. Batch gave only 38.1% conversion in 5 h at 21 bar, indicating severe mass-transfer limitation in stirred autoclave. Flow packed-bed provides 10–50× higher gas-liquid interfacial area (Taylor/trickle flow), expected to dramatically improve H2 delivery to Pd surface. Engineering calculations: τ = 20 min (IF = 15× vs batch), Q_liquid = 0.5 mL/min, V_reactor = 3.0 mL (inventory constraint — reactor_h2_pbr_300). Actual τ = 3.0 mL / 0.5 mL/min = 6.0 min liquid-phase residence time; this is shorter than the 20 min calculation target but is constrained by the fixed 3 mL inventory reactor. The 6 min flow residence time vs 300 min batch time represents a 50× intensification — consistent with mass-transfer-limited regime where flow advantage is large. BPR set to 21 bar (only available setpoint, matches batch pressure exactly). Analogies 1–3 are all dissimilar chemistry (Claisen rearrangement, photocatalytic C-N coupling) and provide no directly applicable hardware parameters; engineering calculations and Chemistry Plan are the primary basis. Particle size of Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 must be confirmed (target dp < 0.435 mm = ID/10 for 4.35 mm ID tube) before packing. Recommended_disposition: SCREEN — first experiment to establish conversion vs residence time baseline; catalyst lifetime and optimal gas:liquid ratio require experimental determination.
chemistry_notes.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety
